ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var bu = String(baseUrl);
var m = bu.match(/id=(\d+)/);
var id = m ? m[1] : '';
var s = mwApi('/api/detail/index?id=' + id);
var j = JSON.parse(s);
var d = j.data || j;
var latest = '';
if (d.chapter_list && d.chapter_list.length) { latest = d.chapter_list[d.chapter_list.length - 1].name || ''; }
var kinds = [];
if (d.serialize) { kinds.push(String(d.serialize)); }
if (d.category_name) { kinds.push(String(d.category_name)); }
var cats = d.categories || d.tags;
if (cats) {
  if (typeof cats === 'string') { kinds.push(cats); }
  else { for (var i = 0; i < cats.length; i++) { var c = cats[i]; kinds.push(typeof c === 'string' ? c : (c.name || '')); } }
}
JSON.stringify({
  name: d.name || '',
  author: d.author || '',
  cover: d.picx || d.pic || '',
  intro: d.description || '',
  kind: kinds,
  latest: latest,
  word: (d.hits != null ? String(d.hits) : ''),
  reName: '',
  durl: '',
  url: mwCurBase() + '/api/chapters/list?book_id=' + (d.id || id)
});
</js>

ruleExplore.author: author
ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var bu = String(baseUrl);
var mi = bu.indexOf('/api/');
var path = mi >= 0 ? bu.substring(mi) : '/api/newest/index?page=1';
path = path.replace(/([?&]tag=)([^&]*)/, function (all, pre, v) {
  try { v = decodeURIComponent(v); } catch (e) {}
  return pre + encodeURIComponent(v);
});
var s = mwApi(path);
var j = JSON.parse(s);
var list = (j.data && j.data.list) || j.data || j.list || [];
if (!(list instanceof Array)) {
  var found = [];
  var seen = {};
  var walk = function (o, depth) {
    if (!o || depth > 6) { return; }
    if (o instanceof Array) { for (var i = 0; i < o.length; i++) { walk(o[i], depth + 1); } return; }
    if (typeof o === 'object') {
      if (o.id && o.name && (o.picx || o.pic) && !seen[o.id]) { seen[o.id] = 1; found.push(o); }
      for (var k in o) { walk(o[k], depth + 1); }
    }
  };
  walk(j.data || j, 0);
  list = found;
}
var out = [];
for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { out.push(mwBookObj(list[i])); }
JSON.stringify({list: out});
</js>
$.list

var kw = km ? km[1].replace(/\+/g, '%20') : '';
try { kw = decodeURIComponent(kw); } catch (e) {}
var pm = bu.match(/[?&]page=(\d+)/);
var pg = pm ? pm[1] : '1';
var s = mwApi('/api/search/index?k=' + encodeURIComponent(kw) + '&page=' + pg);
var j = JSON.parse(s);
var list = (j.data && j.data.list) || j.data || j.list || [];
if (!(list instanceof Array)) { list = list.list || list.items || list.records || []; }
var out = [];
for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { out.push(mwBookObj(list[i])); }
JSON.stringify({list: out});
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var bu = String(baseUrl);
var m = bu.match(/book_id=(\d+)/);
var s = mwApi('/api/chapters/list?book_id=' + (m ? m[1] : ''));
var j = JSON.parse(s);
var list = (j.data && j.data.list) || j.data || j.list || [];
if (!(list instanceof Array)) { list = list.list || list.items || list.records || []; }
var out = [];
for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
  var c = list[i];
  out.push({ title: (c.name || '') + (c.is_vip ? ' [VIP]' : ''), link: mwCurBase() + '/api/chapters/index?id=' + c.id });
}
JSON.stringify({list: out});
</js>
